checks.name: static RTL review
checks.details: Original module name, scalar ports and output reg declarations preserved. Both combinational blocks assign outputs on every branch. No clock, reset, storage or pipeline is required. Constants are one bit.

checks.name: independent self-checking simulation
checks.coverage: All eight binary input combinations in forward and reverse order, including output deassertion transitions.

development_outcome: Initial implementation passed development checks without RTL revisions. candidate_initial.sv was copied immediately after implementation and before checks. Shutdown follows cpu_overheated; driving is enabled only when arrived and gas_tank_empty are both low.
limitations: Official evaluation was not accessed and its outcome is unknown.
Development simulation covers binary inputs; unknown and high-impedance inputs were not tested.
No synthesis, timing analysis or board validation was performed.
Legacy output reg declarations and TopModule naming are retained to match the benchmark interface.
